errors.text_span: На диаграмата са представени четири групи
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly refers to the four data series as 'групи' (groups). In a grouped bar chart, the groups are the categories on the x-axis (the years), while the different bars within each group are called series.

errors.text_span: като някои от тях са групирани или наслагвани
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars might be stacked ('наслагвани'). The chart is a grouped bar chart where all bars are placed side-by-side, not stacked on top of each other.

errors.text_span: а през 2018/2019 тази стойност е малко над 150 000
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value for the category 'Общо в държавни и частни висши училища' in 2018/2019 is slightly above 150,000. The chart clearly shows this value is below the 150,000 mark, at approximately 140,000.
The description fails to mention the most prominent trend in the data: a consistent decrease in the number of students across all categories over the entire period from 2013/14 to 2018/19.
